newsitem.title: USA: U.S. stock markets open on Columbus Day.
newsitem.headline: U.S. stock markets open on Columbus Day.

text.p: All U.S. stock markets will be open regular hours on the U.S. Columbus Day holiday today while the bond market will be closed until October 15.
Business as usual on the New York Stock Exchange, American Stock Exchange and Nasdaq Market System.
Treasury and Municipal bond markets shut.
Normal hours on New York Commodity Exchange, New York Mercantile Exchange, New York Coffee, Sugar and Cocoa Exchange, and New York Cotton Exchange.
Normal hours on foreign exchange markets.

Chicago Mercantile Exchange contracts close at 1200 CDT/1700 GMT except the Goldman Sachs Commodity Index and equity index products, which trade regular hours. GLOBEX trading opens at 1730 CDT/2230 GMT.
Chicago Board of Trade trade in financial and insurance products closed. Agricultural and metals contracts open normal hours.
No afternoon Project A session. Overnight Project A and the evening pit trading open.
CBOT evening pit trading closed Sunday. Overnight Project A session open for agricultural products but closed for financial products.
Chicago Board Options Exchange interest-rate options trade shut. Otherwise, business as usual.
